name: Arudchayan Pirabaharan
headline: Data Research Engineer | Scalable Data Pipelines | Python, Spark & Data Quality
summary: Data research and senior data engineer with 4+ years across industry and independent work building scalable data pipelines, automated processing workflows, and reproducible analytical datasets. Strong in Python, SQL, PySpark, Apache Spark, preprocessing, validation, statistical analysis, and visualization. Experience with multi-source geospatial, financial, ERP, operational, structured, and unstructured enterprise data across Azure, GCP, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Synapse. Applied AI researcher and incoming MSc Data Science student at the University of Basel.

sections.title: Property Data Platform
bullets: Lead Spark-based data workflows for a property-data platform, integrating and validating multi-source property and geospatial data for reliable analytical use.
Drive data-quality, processing-efficiency, and architectural improvements across cloud-native workflows while supporting the platform's continued evolution on GCP.

sections.title: Property Data Platform
bullets: Engineered Spark-based workflows that ingested, transformed, and validated multi-source property and geospatial data into reliable downstream datasets.
Optimized geospatial Spark jobs to improve data quality and processing speed, translating recurring data issues into platform improvements.

Delivered a Microsoft Fabric proof of concept integrating geospatial tools and data; contributed to platform V2 architecture and the Azure-to-GCP migration while preserving continuity and functionality.

sections.title: Applied Data and AI Research
bullets: Conduct applied data and AI research in healthcare through technical investigation and experimentation, translating emerging methods into practical, real-world use cases.
Design and run dataset ablation experiments to evaluate how data selection, preprocessing, and composition affect model performance and behavior.
Use Python, Pandas, NumPy, statistics, exploratory analysis, and visualizations to assess dataset quality, compare experiments, and communicate technical findings.

sections.title: Data Platforms and Applied Analytics
bullets: Designed and implemented reproducible ELT workflows for financial, ERP, and operational datasets used in analysis and reporting.
Built PySpark and SQL transformations in Azure Synapse and Databricks to clean, preprocess, and structure data into analytical lakehouse datasets.
Automated data extraction, orchestration, monitoring, and deployment using PowerShell, Azure Functions, Synapse Pipelines, and Azure DevOps CI/CD.
Developed Power BI datasets and dashboards with emphasis on data quality, consistency, and repeatability.
Contributed to a generative-AI data platform for ingesting and analysing structured and unstructured enterprise data using Azure OpenAI, vector search, APIs, and cloud services.

sections.title: Cloud Data Engineering and Analytics
bullets: Supported production data and AI projects spanning ingestion, transformation, cloud analytics, and reporting using Python, SQL, Spark, and Azure data services.

projects.title: Real-time Data Pipeline Optimization Tool
projects.description: Built a lightweight Python monitoring and visualization tool for Databricks pipelines that automated bottleneck detection and generated recommendations to improve data-processing reliability and efficiency.
